Hand-written fixtures modelled on 1fichier pages (free download form, wait
warnings in English and French, JS countdown, download link page, not found,
password form), the `/dir/<id>?json=1` folder listing and API answers.
`__DL__` and `__WEB__` are replaced by test server URLs. Ids and tokens are fake; the real
page markup changes over time, so keep parse.go tolerant and update these
when it does.
